field.label: Enabled
field.help: Uncheck to ignore this device entirely.

field.label: Name
field.help: A name for this device, shown on the dashboard widget.

field.label: Address
field.help: An IPv4 address or CIDR (192.168.1.50, 192.168.1.0/24), or a MAC address (aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff). A MAC is resolved to the address the device currently holds, so it only works while the device is visible to the firewall and it cannot follow a randomised MAC. An address with a static DHCP reservation is the more reliable choice.

field.label: Mode
field.help: Always allowed, always blocked, or allowed only during the hours below.

field.label: Days
field.help: Days the schedule applies to. On other days the device is blocked.

field.label: Internet allowed from
field.help: The time internet becomes available. A window whose start is later than its end crosses midnight, so 21:00 to 07:00 means overnight.

field.label: Internet allowed until
field.help: The time internet stops being available. Setting this equal to the start time means allowed all day.

field.label: Override
field.help: Temporarily force the device allowed or blocked, ignoring the schedule. The dashboard widget sets this.

field.label: Description
field.help: Optional note for your own reference.
